description: Viking Therapeutics is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company whose lead asset VK2735 — a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist — is in Phase 3 development for obesity. The VANQUISH-1 subcutaneous trial enrolled over 4,650 adults and should produce topline data in 2027; an oral formulation (VANQUISH-2) is also in Phase 3. Viking closed 2025 with approximately $808 million in cash and no product revenue, giving it a runway to Phase 3 readouts without near-term dilution risk. Analysts have set a consensus price target near $99 for 2026, implying material upside contingent on positive Phase 3 results and potential partnership or acquisition interest from a large-cap pharma.
